description: arXiv:2609.16271v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Attribution methods for genomic sequence models are commonly evaluated by how much of a known motif they recover, or by how a prediction degrades as evidence is deleted. Neither score is interpretable without the value it would take by chance, and neither is routinely reported against one. We show that this omission is not a matter of precision...
author: Hyunkyung Han, Min Jung Kim
